module_summary: Sequential 8-bit restoring divider (signed or unsigned): on an accepted start it latches magnitudes, then for 8 iterations trial-adds the negated divisor to the partial remainder in a combined remainder/quotient shift register, and presents sign-corrected {remainder, quotient} with a valid/ready output handshake.

anchors.name: n12_b52
anchors.why: Combined partial-remainder/quotient shift register updated each iteration; holds final result.

anchors.name: n0_70f
anchors.why: Dividend operand, magnitude loaded into the shift register on start.

anchors.name: n2_beb
anchors.why: Divisor operand, negated magnitude stored for trial subtraction.

anchors.name: n20_389
anchors.why: Start request; accepted when idle and no pending result, latching operands.

anchors.name: n18_115
anchors.why: Result valid, set when iterations finish, cleared when consumer accepts.

anchors.name: n6_b16
anchors.why: Consumer ready; with result valid clears the output valid.

anchors.name: n25_17f
anchors.why: Signed-mode select controlling operand magnitude and result sign correction.

anchors.name: n9_ede
anchors.why: Negated divisor magnitude added to partial remainder each iteration.

anchors.name: n3_a62
anchors.why: Iteration counter; bit 3 marks completion and sets result valid.

anchors.name: n17_73a
anchors.why: Busy flag set on start, cleared at completion; gates iterations and new starts.

anchors.name: n13_8f4
anchors.why: Trial-subtract carry: quotient bit and restore/keep select.

anchors.name: n1_b7a
anchors.why: New partial remainder: trial difference or restored value.

anchors.name: n8_f0b
anchors.why: Latched dividend; its sign drives remainder and quotient correction.

anchors.name: n7_362
anchors.why: Latched divisor; its sign drives quotient correction.

anchors.name: n11_048
anchors.why: Quotient field of the shift register before sign correction.

anchors.name: n19_f66
anchors.why: Output handshake fire, clears result valid.

groups.name: div_control
groups.description: Busy flag, iteration counter and result-valid handshake logic.

groups.name: restoring_datapath
groups.description: Trial add of negated divisor, restore select and remainder/quotient shift.

groups.name: operand_latch
groups.description: Latched operands providing signs for correction.

groups.name: sign_correct
groups.description: Two's-complement correction of remainder and quotient outputs.
